compatibility: Page, Path, Text, FidelityReport and FidelityIssue payloads retain import-record-v1 layouts. Layer and Group are additive record types in schema v2.

record_semantics.proposal_order: one Page first; one or more Layer records in source order; Group, Path and Text records in depth-first source order with sequential unique object local IDs; zero or more FidelityIssue records; exactly one FidelityReport last
record_semantics.layer_membership: each object is owned exactly once, directly by a Layer or by one Group; every Group child and Layer root reference resolves to an object record
record_semantics.group_graph: Group references are ordered, acyclic and have one owner; each Group child local ID is greater than its parent local ID
record_semantics.source_ids: nonempty and unique across layers and object records within the proposal
record_semantics.Page: positive page width_mm and height_mm within the selected import profile
record_semantics.FidelityReport: coverage_profile is svg-hierarchy-v2; issue_count equals preceding FidelityIssue record count; unsupported issues are not accepted
record_semantics.FidelityIssue: source_locator is empty or resolves to a source ID in this proposal

svg_profile.group_support: nested SVG g elements retain Group records; root-level Inkscape layers retain Layer records
svg_profile.unsupported_policy: reject entire source and emit no proposal chunks
